This is the SECOND document in my slice mis-joined to faddeev_kashaev1994 (the other is library/arxiv-math-0604094v1/0604094v1.pdf), and both are by the same author — the same confusion seeded twice, presumably because both documents are about the quantum dilogarithm that the registered key's title names. No matching key exists, so id is null. ON THE MERITS it is a lecture-note exposition of the construction that library/arxiv-math-0604094v1/0604094v1.pdf later develops in full — the same content at lower rigour — so that other item is the one to cite. IMPORTANT COLLATERAL: because neither uploaded PDF is the work faddeev_kashaev1994 names, the 9 corpus sites citing that key remain UNVERIFIED against any local document — pentagon-uv-commutation-woronowicz.lean:44 and :297, QOU/QBeta/CyclicDilogPentagon.lean:52, QOU/QBeta/MonodromyDatumRigidity.lean:54, QOU/LiftingDescent/tm_dilogarithm_evaluation.lean:71 and :84, QOU/QuantumObservableUniverses/DilogPentagonAssociator.lean:53, plus q-dilogarithm-pentagon-associator.ts:9 and dilog-pentagon-is-associator.ts:11. keyResults.statement: Exposition of the construction of a knot invariant from the quantum dilogarithm function, in the lineage from the Jones and colored Jones invariants.
keyResults.useForFolio: A secondary locator for the dilogarithm-to-knot-invariant construction underlying the pentagon/associator blocks; superseded in rigour by the other mis-joined document in this same slice.
